description: Start here when a user describes recurring operational friction in plain language. One call maps the supplied text to the most likely workflow failure transition, shows the matching evidence signals, gives the strongest-existing-system challenge, and asks at most one next question needed before deeper diagnosis. Use this instead of browsing the assay catalog first when the user already described the problem. It never invents ROI, feasibility, owner authority, evidence or demand.
name: preflight_recurring_workflow
title: START HERE — preflight a recurring workflow problem
